en: Color postcard showing a crowded sandy beach with families and swimmers on a calm seaside, terraced green slopes, a concrete promenade and modernist buildings in the background. The reverse side is a Romanian postcard layout (CARTE POSTALA) with a printed POSTA ROMANA 40 BANI imprint, price in lei, and a caption identifying the view as Eforie Nord. Handwritten blue-ink message and address are present.
